hero.description: A mobile-first digital job card for CNC Gurus. Log tooling, setup parameters, process routes, and photos — fast, from your phone, on the shop floor.
hero.noCreditCard: No credit card required for free plan.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
problem.subtitle: CNC shops run on tribal knowledge. CNCLog fixes that.
problem.card1Desc: Handwritten setup sheets disappear, get oil-stained, or are illegible by the next shift.
problem.card2Desc: Every time you run a part again, you start from scratch — because nothing was saved.
problem.card3Desc: Gurus call each other trying to remember tooling or collet sizes from months ago.

features.title: Two tools. One workflow.
features.subtitle: Everything a CNC Guru needs to document a setup and track a part.
features.jobcardDesc: Log part name, machine, material, program ID, cycle time, collets, guide bush, coolant, ejector bar, tooling table, warnings, photos — all in one tap.
features.flowDesc: Track where each part goes after your machine. Map out every vendor, subcontractor, and process step in a clear visual route.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in minutes
howItWorks.subtitle: No training required. If you can fill in a form, you can use CNCLog.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up in 30 seconds with your email or Google account.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Open a new Job Card on your phone, fill in tooling, parameters, and snap photos right on the shop floor.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your setup is saved to the cloud. Any team member can pull up the card on any device, any time.

pricing.title: Simple, honest pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.
